{{av}}

'''Fine bricks''' are similar in purpose to regular [[brick]]s, but are five times more valuable. Most regular bricks have an item value of 5{{db}}, while fine bricks have a value of 25{{db}}. Because of their higher value, they are a good choice for [[trade]] goods or improving fortress [[cv:value|value]].

A batch of four fine bricks requires two stone boulders, as opposed to the single-stone requirement of normal [[brick]]s.
